verdict.rationale: RUN's own RUN & DONE feature puts recurring payroll on autopilot, and pay is deposited and payroll taxes filed automatically, so autonomous background execution exists for payroll. There is no evidence of user-configurable, general-purpose automations or AI agents that act on their own. API Central is a developer building block for constructing integrations, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: user-defined automation rules or triggers beyond recurring payroll, agentic AI that takes autonomous actions (the AI features only flag errors, import timesheets and answer questions), and any detailed docs or independent corroboration of how RUN & DONE runs.
